* fix(core): prevent thoughtSignature-only turns and preserve multimodal tool responses  by @tadipavan in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30153

* fix(core): require path-separator boundary in tildeifyPath by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30124
* fix(cli): validate model names and support direct arguments in /model command by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30137

* fix(acp): handle mid-stream retries to prevent text concatenation by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30165
* fix(core,cli): prevent silent multi-minute loading hangs on network failures by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30182
* fix(core,cli): prevent terminal model-turn 400s on resume and main-thread JSONL freezes by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/30186
